entries.jp: 御者
entries.en: Coachman

entries.jp: バーンシュタイン兵
entries.en: Burnstein Soldier

entries.jp: {FFEE}馬車を足止めし、姫を救い出せ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Stop the carriage and rescue the princess!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:007D}む、敵だ！{n}みんな、馬車を守るぞ！{p}{v:007E}馬車はそのまま前進しろ！
entries.en: {v:007D}Hm? The enemy! Everyone, protect the carriage!{p}{v:007E}Keep the carriage moving!
{v:007C}Yes, sir!

entries.jp: {v:007F}あの馬車にお姫様が乗ってるんだね？
entries.en: {v:007F}The princess is in that carriage, right?

entries.jp: {v:0080}この場にいる敵をすべて倒すんだ！{n}それから姫さんを助け出す！
entries.en: {v:0080}Take down every enemy here! Then we get the{n}princess out!

entries.jp: {v:0081}そうはさせるか！
entries.en: {v:0081}I will not let you!

entries.jp: 敵を倒すより、まず橋を落とすことが先決だ。{n}さもないと、敵の援軍がどんどん来るぞ！
entries.en: Bringing down the bridge takes priority over fighting{n}the enemy. Otherwise, their reinforcements will just{n}keep coming!

entries.jp: じゃあ、２手に別れた方がいいの？
entries.en: So should we split into two groups?

entries.jp: それは{s:0000}に任せる。{n}だが西の橋は、できるだけ早く落とすべきだな。{n}敵をうまく避けて、橋の側へ行くぞ！
entries.en: I'll leave that to {s:0000}. But we should{n}bring down the western bridge as soon as we can.{n}Dodge the enemy and get over to it!

entries.jp: ジュリアン様！？{n}こ、これは一体‥‥。
entries.en: Julian-sama?! Wh-what is going on...?

entries.jp: ローランディア軍の襲撃だ！{n}援護をしろ！
entries.en: The Rolandia army is attacking! Provide support!

entries.jp: はっ！{n}了解しました！
entries.en: Yes, sir! Understood!

entries.jp: こ、これは一体‥‥。
entries.en: Wh-what is going on...?

entries.jp: ローランディアの奴らが襲撃してきた！{n}援護してくれ！
entries.en: Those Rolandians are attacking! Back us up!

entries.jp: わ、わかった！
entries.en: G-got it!

entries.jp: {v:0083}この橋を落とすんだね！
entries.en: {v:0083}So we bring down this bridge!

entries.jp: {v:0084}これを落とせばいいのね。
entries.en: {v:0084}This is the one to bring down, then.

entries.jp: {v:0085}この橋を落とすぞ！
entries.en: {v:0085}I'm bringing this bridge down!

entries.jp: {v:0086}このロープを切って‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0086}Just cut this rope...

entries.jp: {v:009E}この兵を突破するのは無理だろう！{n}ハッハッハッハッ！
entries.en: {v:009E}You will never break through these troops! Ha ha{n}ha ha!

entries.jp: {v:008F}い、痛い！{n}何をする、無礼な！
entries.en: {v:008F}Ow! That hurts! What are you doing, you{n}insolent wretch?!

entries.jp: {v:009F}そんな‥‥逃げられちゃうなんて‥‥。
entries.en: {v:009F}No... I can't believe they got away...

entries.jp: {v:009C}フッ。{n}ここまでくれば、あとは走り抜けるだけだ！
entries.en: {v:009C}Heh. Now that we're this far, we need only{n}race through!

entries.jp: {v:009D}ああ、逃げられちゃったよぉ！{n}作戦失敗だぁ！
entries.en: {v:009D}Aaah, they got awaaay! The mission's a failure!

entries.jp: お、お兄ちゃん‥‥。{n}これじゃわたし、テレポート使えない‥‥
entries.en: B-Big Brother... I can't use Teleport like this...

entries.jp: {v:00AC}それじゃ、この作戦自体が成り立たないじゃない！
entries.en: {v:00AC}Then the whole plan falls apart!

entries.jp: くっ、まさか‥‥。{n}ここまで腕を上げていたか‥‥。{p}インペリアル・ナイトになったこの私を倒すとは、{n}さすがだ‥‥。{p}次はこうはいかんぞ、{s:0000}！
entries.en: Ugh, I never imagined... Your skill has improved{n}so much...{p}To defeat me, an Imperial Knight... Impressive indeed...{p}Next time will be different, {s:0000}!

entries.jp: 申し訳ありません、ジュリアン将軍‥‥
entries.en: Forgive me, General Julian...

entries.jp: もう力が出ない‥‥
entries.en: I have no strength left...

entries.jp: 我がバーンシュタイン軍が{n}こんな子供に負けるのか‥‥。
entries.en: Our Burnstein army... defeated by children like these...?

entries.jp: ぐふぅ！
entries.en: Guh!

entries.jp: ま、まだ俺は戦える‥ぞ‥‥
entries.en: I... I can still... fight...

entries.jp: もっと将軍のおそばにいたかった‥‥
entries.en: I wanted to stay by the general's side a little longer...

entries.jp: 少しは将軍の役に立てたよな‥‥
entries.en: I was some use to the general... wasn't I...?

entries.jp: ま、まだ俺は死ねぬ‥‥
entries.en: I... I cannot die yet...

entries.jp: こ、これしきの事で‥‥
entries.en: T-taken down by a trifle like this...

entries.jp: な、なぜ‥‥。
entries.en: Wh-why...?

entries.jp: か、完敗だ‥‥
entries.en: W-we were utterly defeated...

entries.jp: グオッ！
entries.en: Gwah!

entries.jp: こ、これまでか‥‥
entries.en: I-is this the end...?

entries.jp: これでお姫様が連れ去られる心配はなくなったわね。
entries.en: Now we don't have to worry about them taking the{n}princess away.

entries.jp: あとはここの敵をやっつけるだけよ！
entries.en: All that's left is to beat the enemies here!

entries.jp: あとは橋を落として、{n}敵の援軍が来られないようにするだけだね！
entries.en: Now we just have to bring down the bridge so their{n}reinforcements can't get here!
{v:0079}What's going on?!

entries.jp: {v:007A}お、お前たちは！{n}捕虜を奪還しに来たか？{p}{v:007B}馬車は速度を落とすな！{n}全員、奴らの迎撃にあたる！
entries.en: {v:007A}Y-you lot! Have you come to rescue the prisoner?{p}{v:007B}Keep the carriage moving at full speed! Everyone,{n}intercept them!

entries.jp: バカ！{n}今、切ったら馬車までが落ちちゃうじゃない！
entries.en: Idiot! Cut it now and the carriage will fall too!

entries.jp: バカ！{n}今、切ったらお姫様まで落ちちゃうじゃない！
entries.en: Idiot! Cut it now and the princess will fall too!

entries.jp: バカ！{n}今、切っちゃダメでしょ！
entries.en: Idiot! You can't cut it now!

entries.jp: ロープを切って、橋を落としますか？
entries.en: Cut the rope and bring down the bridge?

entries.jp: くっ！
entries.en: Gh!

entries.jp: {v:0087}やった、橋が落ちたよ！
entries.en: {v:0087}Yes! The bridge is down!

entries.jp: {v:0098}そのままでは囲まれる危険がある！{n}馬車を捨てるんだ！
entries.en: {v:0098}You'll be surrounded if you stay there! Abandon{n}the carriage!
{v:008B}Yes, sir!

entries.jp: {v:0089}橋を落として馬車の動きを封じたつもりか！？{p}{v:008A}おい、そのままでは小回りがきかん！{n}馬車を捨てて戦うのだ！
entries.en: {v:0089}You think bringing down the bridge will stop{n}the carriage?!{p}{v:008A}You there! You can't maneuver in that thing! Abandon{n}the carriage and fight!

entries.jp: {v:0092}何っ！？{n}こっちの橋も落とされたか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0092}What?! They've brought down this bridge too...

entries.jp: {v:008D}何っ！？{n}橋を落とされたか！{p}{v:008E}ええい、馬車では小回りがきかん！{n}降りるぞ！
entries.en: {v:008D}What?! They've brought down the bridge!{p}{v:008E}Damn it, we can't maneuver in this carriage! Get out!

entries.jp: {v:0090}さっさとするんだ！
entries.en: {v:0090}Get a move on!

entries.jp: {v:0091}あ、お姫様だ！
entries.en: {v:0091}Oh, there's the princess!

entries.jp: あとは東の橋だけだ。{n}兵の相手は後回しにして、まず橋を落とそう！
entries.en: Only the eastern bridge remains. Leave the soldiers{n}for later. Let's bring down the bridge first!

entries.jp: あとは東の橋だけね。{n}兵の相手は後回しにして、まず橋を落とそうよ！
entries.en: Just the eastern bridge left! Let's leave the soldiers{n}for later and bring down the bridge first!

entries.jp: バカ！{n}今、切ったら、お姫様を助けられないじゃない！
entries.en: Idiot! Cut it now and we won't be able to rescue{n}the princess!

entries.jp: {v:009A}何っ！{n}これでは身動きがとれん！{p}{v:009B}かくなる上は戦うしかあるまい‥‥。
entries.en: {v:009A}What?! We're trapped!{p}{v:009B}Then we have no choice but to fight...

entries.jp: {v:0093}後方の橋が落とされたか‥‥。{p}{v:0094}振り返るな！{n}馬車は速度を落とさず、そのまま進め！
entries.en: {v:0093}They've brought down the bridge behind us...{p}{v:0094}Don't look back! Keep the carriage moving at full speed!
{v:0095}Yes, sir!

entries.jp: {v:0096}後方の橋が落とされたか‥‥。{n}だがこのまま駆け抜ければ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0096}They've brought down the bridge behind us... But if we{n}keep going at full speed...

entries.jp: {v:0097}後は西の橋を落とせば、馬車が孤立するね！
entries.en: {v:0097}Now if we bring down the western bridge, the carriage{n}will be cut off!

entries.jp: {v:008C}くっ！{n}これでは救援に迎えん！
entries.en: {v:008C}Damn! Now we can't get to them to help!

entries.jp: {v:00A9}あ、ダメだ‥‥、お兄ちゃん！
entries.en: {v:00A9}Oh, I can't... Big Brother!

entries.jp: {v:00AA}どうしたの、ルイセちゃん！？
entries.en: {v:00AA}What's wrong, Luise-chan?!

entries.jp: {v:00AB}魔法を使いすぎたみたい。{n}‥‥テレポート出来ない‥‥。
entries.en: {v:00AB}I think I've used too much magic. ...I can't Teleport...
